text: 17-year-old female. The patient presents with a 5-day history of severe abdominal pain and cramping, accompanied by nausea and vomiting. She reports pain with urination and also experienced burning pain during sexual intercourse 3 days ago. She mentions being sexually active with one male partner, using condoms inconsistently.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Pelvic Inflammatory Disease. The combination of severe abdominal pain, vomiting, dysuria, and burning during sexual intercourse in a sexually active 17-year-old female is highly suggestive of PID. I recommend immediate evaluation with a pelvic exam and a urine pregnancy test to rule out ectopic pregnancy before initiating treatment.
